GRADUATING CEREMONIES WILL BE HELD THURSDAY EVENING, 
MAY 16th, FOR 23 STUDENTS OF THE SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
SCHOOL OF RETAILING. THIS 1S THE IOTH YEAR FOR THIS 
UNUSUAL CANADIAN SCHOOL, DURING WHICH PERIOD 225 
GRADUATES HAVE BEEN PREPARED FOR ADVANCED CAREERS IN 
CANADIAN RETAILING. 


THE FASHI™N GROUP OF MONTREAL, INCORPORATED HAVE 
ANNOUNCED PLANS TO MAKE A SPECIAL AWARD AT THE CERE- 


MONIES, 


DESCRIBING THE DIMENSION OF RETAILING IN CANADA, 
PATRICIA M. DUNTON, DIRECTOR OF THE SCHOOL, NOTED RECENTLY 
THAT PERSONAL DISPOSAL INCOME IN CANADA {1S #25 BILLION 
(AFTER TAXES), $17 BILLION OF WHICH IS SPENT BY CANADIANS 
IN RETAIL OUTLETS. ON A PER CAPITA BASIS, THIS WOULD 
MEAN THAT OF A %1),00 INCOME $910 1S SPENT THROUGH RE- 


TAIL SOURCES. 


"IT IS A PARADOX" SHE STATED "THAT RETAILING REPRESENTS 
SUCH AN IMENSE SEGMENT OF THE GROSS NATIONAL PRODUCT, AND 
YET THERE ARE ONLY TWO SCHOOLS IN CANADA, TURNING OUT A 
HANDFULL OF STUDENTS EACH YEAR FORMALLY TRAINED FOR THIS 
FIELD OF WORK.
